lead.title: California Bars Waymo Driverless Taxis From State Freeways
lead.summary: California's Department of Motor Vehicles barred Waymo's driverless taxis from state freeways on 11 November, citing safety concerns after incidents involving construction zones and traffic breaks. The restriction remains in place until Waymo addresses the safety lapses, with no fixed end date set.

The agency selected Lockheed Martin to lead vehicle building and testing for the Quesst mission, with the aircraft designed to reduce the loud sonic boom to a quieter “sonic thump.”

stories.title: Coprod raises $6 million to make ‘robot hardware as easy to build as software’
stories.summary: Coprod raised a $6 million pre-seed round led by Founderful and Prototype to launch compatible robotics hardware components early next year. The company plans to use the funds to build a prototyping facility in Lausanne and establish production in Shenzhen and Texas by 2027.

stories.title: Russian drone explosion interrupts British minister’s speech in Kyiv
stories.summary: An explosion interrupted British Defence Secretary Wes Streeting’s speech at the British Embassy in Kyiv after a Russian drone hit a residential building and restaurant complex on Architect Horodetsky Street. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the drone had been intercepted.

stories.title: Drone Delivery Could Still Be Happening
stories.summary: ExchangeRight Essential Income 11 DST filed a petition in the Horry County Court of Common Pleas on Nov. 19 to reverse the North Myrtle Beach Planning Commission's Oct. 20 denial of Amazon's drone launch paddock. The company argues the commission improperly regulated airspace, a matter reserved for federal regulators, and requested mediation under South Carolina law.

stories.title: NASA Officially Takes Ownership of X-59 Supersonic Aircraft
stories.summary: NASA officially took ownership of the X-59 supersonic aircraft from Lockheed Martin Skunk Works on Nov. 18. The agency selected Lockheed Martin to lead vehicle building and testing for the Quesst mission, with the aircraft designed to reduce the loud sonic boom to a quieter “sonic thump.”

stories.title: Trash-hungry robots roam Japan’s busiest train station
stories.summary: East Japan Railway Company recently completed a 10-week trial of three autonomous trash-collecting robots at Tokyo’s Shinjuku Station. The machines, which stand just over three feet tall, roll along preprogrammed routes through underground concourses between 10 a.m. and 5 p.m. to assist sanitation workers handling waste from nearly three million daily passengers.

stories.title: Attalon, ACS Target Low-Cost Drone Threat With Laser Systems
stories.summary: Defense technology companies Attalon and ACS are combining high-energy lasers with autonomous weapon systems to develop counter-drone defenses for U.S. and allied militaries. The partnership integrates Attalon’s Valaris high-energy laser subsystems with ACS’s Bullfrog autonomous weapon station to produce directed-energy defenses that can be manufactured and deployed at scale.

stories.title: US Drone Makers Face a Metric Screw Gap, UK Supplier Warns
UN warns Black Sea drone attacks threaten food exports as Russia-Ukraine war widens
stories.summary: The UN warned the Security Council that drone attacks on commercial ships in the Black Sea were threatening food exports. Rosemary DiCarlo stated that OHCHR recorded reports of 164 attacks on commercial vessels in the Odesa and Mykolaiv regions of Ukraine from June to October 2026.

stories.title: Pentagon Advances 7 Laser Systems for December Counter-Drone Testing
stories.summary: The Department of Defense invited seven industry teams to participate in the next phase of its directed energy counter-drone technology evaluation, with live-fire testing scheduled for mid-December at Dugway Proving Ground in Utah. The Pentagon’s Office of Research and Engineering and Joint Interagency Task Force 401 selected the seven teams from 13 technical white paper submissions.

also.title: These devastating high-energy lasers will compete in the Pentagon’s Dugway shoot-off

stories.title: Colombia races for counter-drone tech as militant groups embrace drones as frontline weapons
stories.summary: Colombia has suffered at least 93 drone attacks in the first 100 days of President Abelardo de la Espriella's term, killing at least 11 of the 26 Army personnel killed during that period. The Ministry of Defense announced the seizure of a weapons cache containing one drone and 35 grenades on Nov. 8.

stories.title: Canada's Scout Combat Drone Signs 12 Partners Before It Has a Buyer
stories.summary: Dominion Dynamics signed 12 aerospace and defense companies to help build Scout, an uncrewed combat aircraft meant to fly alongside Canada’s crewed fighter jets. The Ottawa company announced the group on November 20, 2026, three days after it named RTX’s Pratt & Whitney Canada as the engine supplier.

stories.title: Xpeng subsidiary's 'flying car' completes tiltrotor transition flight
stories.summary: A subsidiary of Xpeng conducted the first successful flight of the ARIDGE A868, demonstrating its ability to convert between vertical takeoff and high-speed forward cruise. The full-scale tiltrotor vehicle flies a range of ~500 km at a cruise speed of ~360 km/h, targeting business commuting and medium- to long-range air travel.

stories.title: Building a Fully Autonomous Crane System
stories.summary: Researchers from different universities in China developed an autonomous crane system called Autane for rubber tire gantry (RTG) cranes. The system was deployed to over 60 RTGs in multiple port yards and has autonomously handled more than two million 20-foot equivalent units.

stories.title: Tesla Shares Video of a Cybercab Stopping in Austin
stories.summary: Tesla and Elon Musk shared a 12-second video from downtown Austin, Texas, that the original poster says shows a Cybercab stopping while another driver continued. William O’Rourke first posted the clip on November 21, and Tesla’s Robotaxi account shared it the following day.

stories.title: DroneShield's Stationary Counter-Drone System Goes Live for JIATF-401, but Orders Remain the Open Question
stories.summary: DroneShield reported initial operational readiness for a stationary counter-drone system supporting the Pentagon's JIATF-401 task force. The company stated that this milestone does not translate into an additional order, noting that initial operational readiness is distinct from full operational capability.

stories.title: Inside the Tesla Model Y Robotaxi’s Seat and Climate Controls
stories.summary: Tesla lead UI designer Adam Kasprzak shared rider screenshots on November 22 showing the Model Y Robotaxi app’s rear-seat folding controls and separate front and rear climate settings. The images, originally posted by rider Ethan McKanna, display Seat Controls with Fold buttons and a climate screen with tabs for temperature, fan speed, and airflow.

stories.title: Estonian-Ukrainian DOD Solution to integrate AURA AI autonomy platform into drones made by Canada's Draganfly
stories.summary: DOD Solution and Draganfly signed a memorandum of understanding to develop the autonomy of unmanned systems based on the AURA AI platform. The agreement combines DOD Solution's expertise in autonomous systems with Draganfly's Canadian engineering capabilities and system integration expertise.

stories.title: Dubai completes second vertiport for Joby’s electric air taxi service
stories.summary: Skyports Infrastructure and Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority completed the Dubai Marina Vertiport, securing certification from the UAE’s General Civil Aviation Authority for commercial electric vertical take-off and landing operations. The facility, designated VMR, connects with the primary vertiport near Dubai International Airport to form the first route in Dubai’s planned electric air taxi network, with Joby Aviation set to operate the service subject to further approvals.

stories.title: Walt Disney Imagineering Teams Up With Air Taxi Company Archer, and an Avengers: Doomsday Aircraft Kicked It Off
stories.summary: Walt Disney Imagineering R&D and Archer Aviation announced a research collaboration on November 19 to explore creative, technical, and experiential concepts for future transportation. The partnership launched at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix, where Archer displayed its Midnight aircraft in an Avengers: Doomsday livery.

stories.title: What Happens When Police Pull Over a Tesla Cybercab?
stories.summary: Tesla's November 20 first responder guide details how the Cybercab handles traffic stops by parking, switching off self-driving, and flashing hazard lights at twice the usual speed. The vehicle opens a call with Robotaxi Support, lowers windows partway, and unlocks doors if empty, while saving camera footage from before and after the stop.

stories.title: Zelensky: Intelligence has data on Russian drone production volumes; countermeasures are needed
stories.summary: Zelensky said Ukraine needs more F-16s and Gripen aircraft, which are expected to arrive in Ukraine starting in January. He stated that Ukraine needs sanctions, stronger export controls, and means to shoot down Shahed drones.

also.title: Zelenskyy: Intelligence shows scale of Russian plans for jet-powered drone production – countermeasures are needed

stories.title: US flew drone over Mexican territory to help capture drug lord in Sinaloa
stories.summary: The United States flew a surveillance drone over Mexican territory to help authorities capture Fausto Isidro Meza Flores in Sinaloa. The detention triggered violence in Guasave that left 20 people dead, including four soldiers and 16 suspected criminals.

stories.title: Amtrak train strikes vehicle stopped on tracks in Encinitas, two injured
stories.summary: A southbound Amtrak train struck a vehicle stopped on the tracks at an Encinitas rail crossing on Sunday, injuring both occupants. Emergency crews extricated one of the two occupants, and both went to Scripps Memorial Hospital La Jolla.

stories.title: Mobile robotics market set for fifteen-fold growth as autonomous picking expands
stories.summary: IDTechEx projects the combined market for mobile robots, autonomous vehicles, and drones in logistics will expand more than fifteen-fold to reach approximately $233.6 billion in annual equipment revenue by 2046. Intralogistics and mobile picking are expected to remain the largest application segment, representing more than half of the overall market opportunity.

stories.title: Quantum WIY Industries Set New Ukrainian Record: WIY SPYS Drone Flew at Over 500 km/h
stories.summary: Quantum WIY Industries set a new Ukrainian record for the fastest anti-aircraft drone flight, with the WIY SPYS interceptor reaching speeds of up to 527.5 km/h without a payload. The company stated the drone is already used in combat operations and that 75% of its components are Ukrainian-made.

stories.title: Amazon Drones Start Dropping Packages on Rossford Doorsteps Within 30 Minutes
stories.summary: Amazon launched Prime Air drone delivery in Rossford, Ohio, on Sunday, offering packages weighing five pounds or less to customers within 7.5 miles in as fast as 30 minutes. The company plans to reach nearly 500 cities and towns across the United States by the end of 2026.

stories.title: Powerus turns existing boats into crewless drone launchers
stories.summary: U.S. drone maker Powerus is offering to convert existing military boats into crewless drone carriers using its Blue Sky Horizon system. The company adds launch rails to the bow to extend drone range, citing footage from Ukraine's 40th Separate Marine Brigade that showed uncrewed boats carrying heavy drones toward Russian lines.

stories.title: US Navy Counts 3 Drones at Sigonella. Italian Sources Describe One
stories.summary: The US Navy reported detecting three drones near Naval Air Station Sigonella in Sicily on November 20, while Italian Air Force sources described a single small civilian quadcopter that flew over base housing without reaching the runway. The airfield closed until 8:30 p.m. local time, and Carabinieri are investigating the unauthorized flight.

stories.title: Bundeswehr Flies Helsing, Stark Strike Drones 12 Miles From Belarus
stories.summary: German soldiers flew Helsing and Stark strike drones at tanks on November 22 at the Rūdninkai training ground in Lithuania, about 12 miles from the Belarus border. It was the German Army’s first tactical test of loitering munitions, nine months after the Bundestag’s budget committee approved the first 536 million euros to buy them.

stories.title: Ukraine’s Farsight Vision Brings Battle-Tested AI Drone Navigation to the Netherlands
stories.summary: Farsight Vision and BSS Holland signed a memorandum of cooperation to jointly develop, integrate, and promote defense technology solutions for the Dutch market. The agreement does not currently include a concrete contract or a specific list of systems for the Dutch military to purchase.

stories.title: Vertical Aerospace Completes Construction of Bristol Powertrain Facility
National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH) Center for Occupational Robotics Research (CORR); Request for Information
stories.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health requests public input on research priorities and prevention needs related to humanoid robots in workplaces. Through its Center for Occupational Robotics Research, NIOSH seeks information on workplace applications, human-robot interaction, and performance measurement.

stories.title: Spotlight on: Rail Infrastructure
stories.summary: Australia’s capital cities are undergoing a transformative rail boom, with major projects active or recently completed in Perth, Sydney, Brisbane, and Melbourne. These initiatives include Perth’s 72-kilometre Metronet plan, Sydney’s Metro City Line, Brisbane’s Cross River Rail, and Melbourne’s 90-kilometre Suburban Rail Loop.

stories.title: Amazon Drones Reach Toledo: 3 Ohio Hubs in 59 Days, None on FAA Index
stories.summary: Amazon launched Prime Air drone delivery in the Toledo area on November 22, operating from a Rossford fulfillment center to customers within 7.5 miles. This marks Amazon’s third Ohio drone site in 59 days, following launches in North Randall and Etna, with the FAA’s public environmental review index listing no Amazon documents for these locations.

stories.title: Türkiye launches call for domestic humanoid robot development
stories.summary: The Industry and Technology Ministry launched a call for proposals on Monday to develop domestic humanoid robots for industrial applications, offering a 50% grant on eligible costs for projects up to 48 months. The program requires robots to stand at least 1.6 meters tall, carry 15 kilograms per arm, and lift 35 kilograms with both arms, with applications due by Dec. 31.

stories.title: Yangtze River Delta Infrastructure Upgrade: 3 New High-Speed Railways Opening Soon + Northern Anhui County-Level Factory Construction Accelerates to Shore Up Regional Weak Points
stories.summary: Three high-speed railways in Anhui, including the Chaohu-Ma'anshan line, began trial operation at the end of October, connecting five counties to the national network for the first time. The new lines reduce travel times, such as cutting the Hefei-Ma'anshan trip to under one hour, and link northern Anhui to the national trunk network.

stories.title: Portal North Bridge completed to address New Jersey rail bottleneck
stories.summary: NJ Transit and Amtrak began using both tracks of the new Portal North Bridge near Kearny on the Northeast Corridor as part of the trans-Hudson Gateway Programme.

stories.title: Rail News - Ohio commission approves funding for 3 rail projects. For Railroad Career Professionals
stories.summary: The Ohio Rail Development Commission approved funding assistance for three rail projects in Putnam, Butler and Adams counties, accounting for nearly $151 million in investments. The commission approved a $90,000 grant for Weidmann Electrical Technology and a $140,000 grant for Winchester Ag Service Inc.

stories.title: Zipline Files for a Tacoma Drone Hub Before the FAA Clears Seattle
stories.summary: Zipline filed building and site-development permit applications with the City of Tacoma on November 19 for a drone charging hub at 4810 Center St., requesting four drone charging stations, fencing, electrical service, a networking cabinet, and buried conduit. The applications are pending intake screening, and The News Tribune reports the building application puts the start of work in January.

stories.title: Amazon's Drones Are Now in the NYT, WSJ and The Times. That's Good
stories.summary: The New York Times, Wall Street Journal, and The Times of London published reports on Amazon Prime Air drone operations between November 18 and 22. The Wall Street Journal noted that about 30 drones an hour leave the Baton Rouge hub, while The Times reported that a customer in Darlington, England, was never offered drone delivery despite the service covering roughly 8,000 households.

stories.title: Amazon Drones Fly Over Mt. Juliet With Nashville Still 'Coming Soon'
Amazon Delivery Drone Strikes Wire, Lands on Michigan Garage Roof
stories.summary: An Amazon Prime Air drone struck a fiber-optic line and landed on a garage roof in Huntington Woods, Michigan, on November 20, causing no injuries. The MK30 aircraft lost a propeller after delivering shampoo, and DTE Energy temporarily disconnected power to remove it from the roof.

also.title: Amazon Drone Hit a Wire and Came Down on a Garage, Customer Says
Another MK30 down: how many eggs does Amazon need to break before someone gets hurt?
Amazon Drone Crashes into Michigan Garage After Completing Delivery
Amazon delivery drone crashes into roof after completing shampoo delivery

stories.title: Congressional Report Highlights National Security Role of Commercial Drone Manufacturing
stories.summary: The House Select Committee on the Strategic Competition Between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party identified commercial drone manufacturing as a critical component of U.S. national security in its report, Rigging the Game. The committee argued that domestic production capacity for drones and components like batteries is essential for military readiness, noting that DJI’s commercial dominance parallels China’s military drone capabilities.

stories.title: Strong Presses FBI on Redstone Counter-Drone Role
stories.summary: Rep. Dale Strong questioned FBI Deputy Director Christopher Raia and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin about Redstone Arsenal's counter-drone role during the House Homeland Security Committee's annual hearing in mid-November 2026. The session examined the FBI's National Counter-UAS Training Center, established within the last 21 months, as part of federal efforts to detect and respond to unmanned aircraft 25 years after the Sept. 11 attacks.

stories.title: Zipline CEO: 3 Partners Each Want a Million Drone Deliveries a Day
stories.summary: Zipline CEO Keller Rinaudo Cliffton says three or more partners are each trying to buy more than a million drone deliveries a day from the company. He named Uber Eats and Walmart as two of the partners, noting Zipline’s new plan asks whether it can scale three to five times faster over the next two years.

stories.title: Northrop Grumman Highlights 500,000 Hours of Autonomous ISR Flight Experience
stories.summary: Northrop Grumman highlighted more than 500,000 hours of autonomous flight experience in a November 19, 2026, announcement promoting its intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance and targeting capabilities. The company outlined its approach to combining autonomous aircraft, including the RQ-4 Global Hawk and MQ-4C Triton, with multi-domain sensors and real-time data processing to provide timely intelligence to military decision-makers.

stories.title: FCC Reports $6 Billion in U.S. Drone Manufacturing Investment as Conditional Approvals Expand
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) reports $6 billion in U.S. drone manufacturing investment and 5,700 jobs since December 2025, following the expansion of its Covered List to include foreign-produced drones. The agency granted five conditional approvals on November 18, allowing specific foreign products to enter the U.S. market despite restrictions, with 71 companies now holding such approvals across four equipment categories.

also.title: FCC Exempts 23 Drone Makers From Its Ban for US Factory Pledges

stories.title: Pesa to build prototype Polish hydrogen trains in innovation partnership deal
stories.summary: Regional passenger train operator Koleje Dolnośląskie selected Pesa Bydgoszcz for an innovation partnership deal to supply electric-battery-hydrogen multiple-units. The trains will enable zero-emission through running between electrified and non-electrified lines.

stories.title: Defense Department continues Autonomous Vehicle Orchestrator Challenge
stories.summary: The Department of Defense launched the Autonomous Vehicle Orchestrator (AVO) Challenge in January to develop market-ready software for coordinating unmanned vehicles. The program is evaluating how well competing solutions integrate diverse systems and reduce operator burden while validating capabilities during live testing.

stories.title: Drone attack on Russian corvette: Defence Ministry says Albania took no part
stories.summary: Albania’s Ministry of Defence denied claims that it participated in a naval drone attack on a Russian warship off the coast of Libya, stating the allegation lacks verifiable evidence regarding the drones' launch site or operators. The ministry confirmed that Albanian Armed Forces neither carried out nor supported the operation, contradicting reports that drones traveled more than 800 kilometres from Albanian territory.

stories.title: Belgian F-16s carry FZ275 counter-drone rockets for first time in NATO Baltic Mission over Latvia
stories.summary: Two Belgian Air Force F-16AM fighters carried Thales Belgium's FZ275 70 mm laser-guided counter-drone rockets over Riga on November 18, 2026, marking their first known operational carriage on NATO's Baltic Air Defence mission. Deployed from Šiauliai Air Base in Lithuania, the loadout addresses the cost imbalance of intercepting low-cost drones with conventional missiles.

stories.title: Embrace the friction: Danish partnership seeks to grow rail tourism
stories.summary: Tourism and city leaders and rail industry representatives launched the Partnership For International Train Tourism initiative in Denmark to increase leisure travel by rail.

stories.title: Vertical Aerospace Achieves AS9100 Aerospace Quality Certification for Valo eVTOL
stories.summary: Vertical Aerospace achieved AS9100 certification from the British Standards Institution, confirming its quality management system meets standards used by Airbus and Boeing. The company plans to begin assembly of its first certification-conforming aircraft in Q4 2027, targeting type certification in 2029.

stories.title: Turkish defense firm STM delivers first batch of Alkan kamikaze drones
stories.summary: Turkish defense firm STM delivered the first batch of its domestically developed Alkan kamikaze drones to security forces after completing acceptance tests. The system features a 10-kilometer range, fiber-optic operation to counter electronic jamming, and can carry anti-personnel or armor-piercing warheads.

stories.title: eVTOL Insights publishes November Digital Magazine featuring VINI | flyvbird’s Tomislav Lang and Stefan Klocke in CEO Interview
Swiftstrike and Naturik receive funding for Baltic Sea C-UAS
stories.summary: Swiftstrike and Nautrik received nearly SEK 7 million from Vinnova to develop a counter-unmanned aerial system for maritime operations in the Baltic Sea. The project, running until October 2027, will integrate the system with Nautrik’s autonomous vessels to protect ships and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: olee.space Secures DRDO Contract to Develop Laser-Based Drone Communication System
stories.summary: Deep-tech company olee.space secured a contract from the Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO) to develop an indigenous laser-link communication system for drones. The project involves designing ground-based and airborne Free Space Optical Communication terminals with automatic tracking technology, expected for completion within 18 months.

stories.title: Ascendance Unveils Full-Scale ATEA Hybrid-Electric VTOL Aircraft
Drone test centre to be established in Abu Dhabi
stories.summary: Abu Dhabi’s Integrated Transport Centre said on 23 November that it will collaborate with KEZAD Group to develop a test hub for drone and autonomous vehicle technologies. The partners will assess requirements and use suitable locations to conduct trials, aiming to support research and contribute to regulatory frameworks for future adoption.

stories.title: University of Arizona’s Scottsdale Center confirmed as venue for eVTOL Insights’ North America Conference & Awards 2027
World rail contract news round-up
stories.summary: Göteborg’s municipal transport operator donated the first of a fleet of M29 trams to Mykolaiv, Ukraine, which has arrived at its new home.

stories.title: Japan-style township planned around Virar bullet train station
stories.summary: The Vasai-Virar City Municipal Corporation approved a draft Local Area Plan for a 464-hectare township around the Virar bullet train station, making it the first civic body in Maharashtra to announce such a plan. The project, assisted by the Japan International Cooperation Agency, allocates 176.85 hectares for residential use and 148 hectares for retained forest land.

stories.title: Closing Canada’s robotics gap starts with operational readiness
U.S. Army says 101st Airborne demonstrates drone-delivered firepower with DARK and BLADE during live-fire
stories.summary: Soldiers from the U.S. Army’s 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault) used drones to deliver smoke and explosive munitions during live-fire training at Fort Campbell. The Nov. 2-8, 2026, exercise integrated the Drone Agnostic Release Kit (DARK) and Broad Lethality Air Deployed Effects (BLADE) to support simulated infantry operations.

stories.title: Robotics in 2027: The Winners Will Be Measured in Hours Without Human Help
stories.summary: The author predicts that in 2027, robotics suppliers and operators will make labor burdens visible by reporting interventions per task or operating hour. Commercial pilots will demonstrate bounded recovery using learned models on the robot itself, allowing machines to recognize failed attempts and choose allowed responses without network round trips.

stories.title: Vectigo launches road-embedded safety system for autonomous vehicles in Colorado
stories.summary: Vectigo, a Colorado-based company, launched a roadway-embedded safety platform using solar-powered sensor units to detect hazards like black ice and wrong-way drivers. The company aims to reach every state department of transportation within five years.

stories.title: Qatar begins phase two of electric Robotaxi test runs
stories.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Transport began phase two of electric robotaxi test runs in Doha, featuring two level-4 vehicles on specific routes for 12 months. This follows a first phase that covered nearly one million kilometers, exceeding the 500,000-kilometer goal.

stories.title: Mainline GWR rail passengers to get Wi-Fi created for F1 cars
stories.summary: Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander confirmed Treasury funding for satellite Wi-Fi on Great Western Railway trains, a hybrid system using low earth orbit satellites and mobile masts originally developed for Formula 1 cars. The rollout will serve passengers in the South West as GWR enters public ownership in December.

stories.title: NATO Reconnaissance Aircraft Monitors Kaliningrad Region During Drone Attack
stories.summary: A NATO Boeing E-3A Sentry surveillance aircraft monitored the drone attack on Russia’s Kaliningrad region on November 21. The aircraft, identified by callsign NATO01, took off from Geilenkirchen Air Base in Germany and patrolled Polish airspace near Kaliningrad, circling near Gdańsk from 7:30 p.m. to 8:20 p.m. local time before moving toward Ostrołęka and eventually heading to Talsi Airbase in Latvia.

stories.title: Gun-toting 'robot dogs' storm gang-controlled stadium where human skulls were found
stories.summary: El Salvador's military deployed armed robotic dogs to assist in clearing the Sylvio Cator Stadium in Haiti, where troops discovered human skulls. The joint task force, comprising Salvadoran Special Forces and Haitian security units, reclaimed control of the stadium, which will now be converted into an operational base.

stories.title: Darmstadt robotics startup Telekinesis wins Frankfurt’s 2026 Startup of the Year award
stories.summary: Telekinesis, a robotics company spun out of TU Darmstadt, was named Frankfurt Forward Startup of the Year 2026 during the EURO FINANCE Tech Day in Frankfurt. The company develops a cloud-based platform to simplify the programming and autonomous control of various robotic systems, including industrial robots, drones, and humanoid platforms.

stories.title: Renegade UxS Shows Nightmare Drone at Fort Bragg
stories.summary: Renegade UxS Inc. set up a booth at Modern Warfare Week, held November 16-19 at Fort Bragg and nearby sites in the Fayetteville, North Carolina, area. The company's Nightmare FPV drone joined the U.S. government's Blue UAS Cleared List in December 2025.

also.title: Maker of combat-proven Ukraine drone courts US special forces

stories.title: Morocco ranks second in Africa with 271 military drones, database shows
stories.summary: Morocco's military drone fleet expanded to 271 units last year, ranking second in Africa behind Egypt's 313, according to Unmanned Africa data. The Royal Armed Forces acquired 164 drones in 2020 alone, with Israeli-made aircraft comprising approximately 65% of the inventory.

stories.title: Ukrainian Mirage 2000 shoots down Russian jet drone with gun
stories.summary: A French-supplied Mirage 2000 fighter shot down a Russian jet-powered attack drone with its built-in DEFA 554 30mm cannon, according to footage released by Ukraine’s Air Force. The Air Force published the video with a caption thanking the pilot for the accuracy.

also.title: German-Ukrainian SPYS interceptor drone shoots down Russian jet-powered Geran-5

stories.title: I saw Russian power from the inside. This is how Ukraine’s drones are really h
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries this year have produced spectacular images of raging fires – and some breathtaking estimates of the damage done. The Wall Street Journal recently put the affected capacity of Russia’s output at 59 per cent, while Bloomberg reported 40 per cent and Reuters roughly 30 per cent.

stories.title: EU Drone Projects: The Art of Doing a Lot, Yet Producing Nothing
stories.summary: Stakeholder feedback at the EU Drone Summit in November 2026 indicated that 59% saw no significant progress in U-space implementation, while 34% reported moderate progress and none reported good progress. The European Commission is still reviewing progress on the EU Drone Strategy 2.0, introduced in 2022, and is preparing another implementation roadmap expected in 2027.

stories.title: DropShip autonomous cargo aircraft heads for serial production
stories.summary: Pyka’s DropShip autonomous cargo aircraft is moving toward serial production after a second airframe completed ground testing. The company plans to conduct flight testing and real-world demonstrations next, following the first aircraft’s maiden flight in April.

stories.title: San Antonio council members push Austin rail as studies price two routes
stories.summary: San Antonio City Council members pushed for Austin-San Antonio passenger rail as two studies price the link at $810 million to $13.5 billion. District 7 Council Member Marina Alderete Gavito filed a Council Consideration Request on Nov. 16, 2026, asking for a hearing at the earliest available meeting of the council’s Governance Committee.

stories.title: U.S. naval supremacy threatened as underwater arms race gains steam: ‘Underwater drones will likely reshape the future of war fighting at sea,’ expert says
stories.summary: Morgan Bazilian, director of the Colorado School of Mines’ Payne Institute for Public Policy, stated that the United States lacks the industrial capacity to build underwater drones at scale. He warned that underwater drones “will likely reshape the future of war fighting at sea.”

stories.title: Ukrainian authorities warn people may be trapped under rubble after Russian drone attack
stories.summary: Search and rescue operations were ongoing with emergency crews removing the debris of the damaged structure and searching for those potentially trapped.

stories.title: MIT voxel blocks let imprecise robots build load-bearing demos
stories.summary: MIT visiting researcher Miana Smith developed voxel blocks that absorb 10 millimeters of placement error, allowing low-cost robots to assemble load-bearing structures. Her first field partner, Druk Holding and Investments, plans an outdoor test for housing at Gelephu Mindfulness City, while Smith targets concrete formwork next.

stories.title: Boom Supersonic Runs Prototype Core of In-House Engine for First Time
stories.summary: Boom Supersonic test engineers ran the prototype core of the company's in-house engine for the first time on Nov. 21 at the Colorado Air and Space Port in Watkins. The core reached 6,500 rpm with nearly 2,000 real-time sensors, and Boom expects to expand the test envelope over the next two months.

stories.title: This shape-shifting robot looks like real transformer; can bend, grab and combine for new role
stories.summary: Colorado State University’s Adaptive Robotics Lab researchers developed the TeCoBot, a 23-inch flexible robot that can bend, grab, and combine with others to form new machines. While the robots demonstrated autonomous docking, most movements and cooperative tasks still require human control.

stories.title: Six Chennai Metro stations may wait until mid-2027 for automated train trials
stories.summary: Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) may delay opening six Phase II stations on the Porur–Vadapalani section until mid-2027, as civil works finish by early 2027 but automated train trials remain incomplete. The stations can open only after trains run in Automatic Train Operation (ATO) mode and the Commissioner of Metro Railway Safety grants clearance, with one official stating that CMRS will not accept trains operated in manual mode.

stories.title: Riding Brightline From Miami to Orlando: 11 Things First-Timers Should Know
Akinci drone drops Türkiye's ORKA torpedo in first unmanned release
stories.summary: Baykar's Bayraktar Akinci drone dropped Roketsan's ORKA torpedo in the first unmanned release of the national weapon, a test conducted over the Gulf of Saros. The 220-kilogram torpedo, which has a 15-kilometer range, separated safely from the aircraft's wing and entered the water at the designated point.

stories.title: From Gaming Screens To The Battlefield: Malaysia's Search For A New Breed Of Drone Operators
stories.summary: Malaysia's Chief of Defence Force, General Tan Sri Malek Razak Sulaiman, said the Armed Forces are exploring video gaming experience to identify recruits for an expanding military drone programme. The initiative supports intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance missions in the South China Sea and waters off Sabah, following the induction of Turkish-made ANKA-S unmanned aerial systems into No. 11 Squadron at Labuan Air Base.

stories.title: Korea National Railway group wins Vietnam high-speed rail design retender
stories.summary: A consortium including Korea National Railway, Systra, and TEDI won the retendered Vietnam high-speed rail feasibility study and front-end engineering design package, valued at about VND 10.8 trillion. Korea’s Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced the award on November 21, with work scheduled from November 2026 to May 2029.

also.title: Korean consortium wins Vietnam high-speed rail design contract
Vietnam picks French-Korean group for high-speed rail deal

stories.title: How the Conflict in Ukraine is Driving Changes in US Drone Use, Base Security, and Military Organization
Humanity’s Supersonic Dream: How Concorde Conquered the Atlantic and Why It Disappeared from the Skies
stories.summary: British Airways and Air France inaugurated scheduled supersonic services to New York from London and Paris on 22 November 1977. Concorde covered the route in less than three and a half hours, allowing passengers to arrive in New York earlier than they departed London.

stories.title: Neural Network With Sliding Data Window Enhances Autonomous Ship Path
stories.summary: Maritime researchers developed an adaptive predictive control framework that enhances autonomous ship path following by merging a feedforward neural network with a real-time sliding data window. Validated through numerical simulations of the commercial car carrier vessel Hual Trooper, the system stabilizes underactuated vessels along planned rhumb lines without relying on rigid physical mechanism equations.

stories.title: California man tests Mercedes' answer to Tesla’s Full Self-Driving and finds out something he didn't expect
stories.summary: YouTuber Everyday Chris tested Mercedes' MB Drive Assist Pro in San Francisco, noting the system uses 10 cameras, five radar sensors, and 12 ultrasonic sensors. The city-driving feature launches in California in December 2026, with a broader U.S. rollout starting in 2027.

stories.title: Kentucky County Drone Finds Escaped Man After 13-Hour Manhunt
stories.summary: Adair County Emergency Management used a drone to locate Deon Bostic, who escaped custody in Columbia, Kentucky, after 13 hours. Kentucky State Police arrested Bostic in a field near Breeding on Saturday, November 21, after he was spotted walking in a field.

stories.title: Ukraine, UK Agree to Jointly Produce Ukrainian Deep-Strike Drones in Britain
stories.summary: Ukraine and the UK signed project agreements on Saturday, Nov. 21, to jointly produce battlefield-proven Ukrainian middle-strike and deep-strike drones in Britain. Funded by London, the finished drones will be delivered directly to the Armed Forces of Ukraine, according to Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense.

also.title: UK to produce 'middle strike,' long-range drones for Ukraine in Britain

stories.title: Uber and Momenta Launch Robotaxi Pilot in Munich
stories.summary: Uber and Momenta launched a supervised autonomous vehicle pilot in Munich, offering the first autonomous rides through the Uber app in Germany. The free, non-commercial service operates under special test permits from the Federal Motor Transport Authority (KBA) and covers a defined area in northern Munich, including neighborhoods surrounding the Olympic Park. A trained safety operator remains on board every vehicle, and selected pre-registered riders can access the service via the Uber app.

stories.title: Tesla launches Cybercab, fueling speculation of SpaceX merger
stories.summary: Tesla initiated sales of its new Cybercab, an autonomous electric vehicle available exclusively to select U.S. customers. The launch supports Tesla’s plan to enhance robotaxi services by 2027, fueling speculation about a possible merger with SpaceX, though no official announcements have been made.

stories.title: Bill Aims to Study How Self-Driving Vehicles Can Be Integrated Into Illinois Transit
Most Prime Air drone orders arrive in under 90 minutes, Amazon says
Air defenses down 161 of 186 Russian drones launched against Ukraine since evening
stories.summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 161 of 186 Russian drones launched against Ukraine since the evening of November 21. The attack involved Shahed, Gerbera, and Parodiya-type drones, with hits recorded at 18 locations and debris falling at six.

stories.title: China displays advanced AI, robotics, and manufacturing ahead of APEC conference
stories.summary: China is demonstrating its latest developments in artificial intelligence, robotics, and manufacturing in Shenzhen and Guangzhou ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation conference. Highlights include service robots for various tasks, a robotic arm capable of deep-sea diving, autonomous electric helicopters and air taxis, and a partially automated electric vehicle assembly line in Guangzhou.

stories.title: LAPD Chief Warns of Weaponized Spray Drones at the 2028 Olympics
stories.summary: Los Angeles Police Chief Jim McDonnell says agricultural spray drones from California’s Central Valley could be weaponized against the 2028 Olympics, and that getting technology, training and authorizations up to speed for drone threats is going to be a challenge. His comments were part of an ABC7 Los Angeles report on Olympic security planning published Saturday, with about 600 days left before the Games open.

stories.title: Record tram orders: how Stadler, Škoda, CAF and Alstom dominate Europe’s renewal wave
stories.summary: The London Court of International Arbitration ordered Ethiopian Railways Corp to pay Turkish contractor Yapı Merkezi US$307.6m, concluding a dispute over construction works for the Awash – Kombolcha – Hara Gebeya railway which were suspended because of the war in Tigray.

stories.title: Lithuanian-speaking robot joins library staff: âIt can read, tell stories'
stories.summary: Gargždai Public Library will add ALTAS, a Lithuanian-speaking humanoid robot, to its staff starting the New Year. The robot, the first in Lithuania designed specifically for library work, will answer visitor questions and recommend books by genre. Library director Aurelija Butkutė-Norkevičienė said the team is refining its pronunciation and plans to use ALTAS for children's events and to engage students with special educational needs.

stories.title: Muncie Bill Would Put Every Police Drone Purchase to a Council Vote
stories.summary: Three members of the Muncie, Indiana, City Council filed an ordinance on November 17 that would bar every city agency from buying, leasing or accepting a drone without a council vote first. The bill follows months of local reporting on police license plate cameras from Flock Safety, and it orders any plate readers installed on city property without council approval to be switched off and removed.

stories.title: Lithuania denies involvement in drone attack near Kaliningrad
stories.summary: Lithuanian Foreign Minister Kęstutis Budrys denied involvement in a drone incident near Kaliningrad, stating Lithuania never authorized the use of its airspace for attacks on Russian territory. Governor Alexey Besprozvannykh reported air-raid sirens activated in the Neman district on 21 November after detecting a suspicious object, though no damage or casualties were confirmed.

also.title: Lithuania Denies Role in Kaliningrad Drone Strike

stories.title: Russia Reports 170 Ukrainian Drones Shot Down Overnight
stories.summary: The Russian Defense Ministry stated that air defenses downed 170 Ukrainian drones overnight on November 22. Officials reported one dead, seven injured, and damage to homes and vehicles.

stories.title: US Army demonstrates autonomous drone swarm launched from unmanned ground vehicle in Germany
stories.summary: The US Army demonstrated an R3NEGADE unmanned ground vehicle deploying multiple drones from a HIV3 swarm launcher at the Grafenwoehr Training Area on November 12, 2026. The aircraft carried out a coordinated autonomous attack, showcasing an approach designed to extend the reach of ground formations while keeping personnel farther from hostile positions.

stories.title: Andromeda Robotics raises $30 million to accelerate expansion of Abi companion robot
stories.summary: Andromeda Robotics raised approximately US$30 million in a planned US$75 million equity offering to expand its Abi companion robot across aged care facilities. The company disclosed the funding in a US Securities and Exchange Commission filing on 13 November, following the deployment of 22 robots in Australia and the start of a 12-month study in California.

stories.title: Smoke reported in Russian city of Krasnodar after drone attack and explosions – photos
stories.summary: Smoke was reported in Krasnodar following a drone attack and explosions near the Russian National Guard headquarters. Temporary restrictions were announced at Krasnodar Airport on the night of 21-22 November, and the city administration stated that the drone attack had been repelled.

also.title: Drones Strike Rosgvardiya Headquarters in Krasnodar
Ukrainian Drones Reportedly Hit Russian National Guard Headquarters Deep Inside Russia

stories.title: Physical AI value may move from robot hardware to deployment, McKinsey finds
stories.summary: McKinsey now expects physical AI to generate over $1 trillion in value by 2035, moving that milestone forward from 2040. The firm predicts value will shift from robot hardware to software, deployment, and field operations, where site data and integrator skills become central assets.

stories.title: Student drone teams competed at Turkey Dash on the Wabash in Terre Haute
stories.summary: Student drone teams from Indiana and Mississippi competed at the second annual Turkey Dash on the Wabash at Terre Haute Regional Airport on Saturday, Nov. 21. Twenty-eight teams participated in events testing piloting, autonomous programming, and teamwork, while the Next Level Drone Expo connected students with professionals from the Federal Aviation Administration and other organizations.

stories.title: Drone locates 2 seriously hurt in UTV crash in Eloy
stories.summary: A drone located two seriously injured individuals in a utility task vehicle crash in Eloy.

stories.title: BMW And Mercedes Give Up On “Sophisticated” Autonomous Driving
Nigeria Seeks EU Support in Counter-Drone Technology, Intelligence Sharing
China advances in humanoid and quadruped robot chips with 700 TOPS platform and new tech headquarters

A Ukrainian serviceman prepares a Gara, a multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with artificial intelligence elements, before flying it over positions of Russian troops, near the frontline in Ukraine's Donetsk region in May. UN diplomats met in Switzerland this week to discuss AI use in war.
stories.summary: UN-backed talks on regulating AI in warfare ended Saturday with nations agreeing to further discussion, but without a consensus on developing firm rules on how to rein in deadly autonomous weapons.

stories.title: AI, stealth fighters, 100,000 drones: Pak military is overhauling itself quietly
stories.summary: Pakistan's armed forces initiated a multi-domain transformation following the May 2025 clash with India, increasing defense services expenditure by 17.65% to PKR 3 trillion in the FY 2026-27 budget. The allocation for physical assets surged by 39.63% to PKR 925.83 billion, while the state-owned National Radio and Telecommunication Corporation finalized a three-year agreement for 100,785 unmanned systems.

stories.title: Tesla Stock: Elon Musk Confirms FSD v15 December Release, Robotaxi Expansion Nears
stories.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk confirmed that Full Self-Driving version 15 will receive a wide release in December 2026, connecting consumer vehicles with technology developed for the company's dedicated robotaxi fleet. The update remains supervised and does not authorize unsupervised driving, which Tesla plans to make available to eligible privately owned vehicles around the second quarter of 2027.

stories.title: WATCH: Tesla Optimus Humanoid Robot Walks Beside Elon Musk Carrying His Two Suitcases Off Private Jet; Scene Reminds Users Of A Sci-Fi Movie
stories.summary: Tesla's Optimus humanoid robot carried two suitcases beside chief executive Elon Musk as he disembarked from a private jet, a scene that drew widespread social media attention. The robot, developed by Tesla's artificial intelligence and robotics engineering teams, is engineered to perform repetitive tasks and assist with routine domestic and workplace chores.

stories.title: Ukrainian drones are attacking Russia’s Kaliningrad exclave for the first time
stories.summary: Ukrainian monitoring channels described drone activity near Russia’s Baltic Fleet base in Baltiysk as the first reported attack on Kaliningrad Oblast in the war. Air-raid sirens sounded in Kaliningrad city and surrounding districts from around 19:00 local time on the evening of 21 November.

also.title: Russia’s Kaliningrad Region was attacked by drones for the first time – the Baltic Fleet base may have been targeted
Kaliningrad Drone Claims: What Ukrainian Channels and Russian Officials Say
Russia’s Baltic Fleet Base Comes Under First-Ever Suspected Drone Attack in Kaliningrad

stories.title: Advanced Pakistan drones test security agencies
stories.summary: Security agencies in India struggle to block drones crossing from Pakistan into Punjab up to four or five times a day, which sources say are equipped with advanced satellite communication and navigation systems that make them difficult to track.

stories.title: Samsung, SK hynix and Micron unite to standardize robot charging and enhance chip factory automation
stories.summary: Samsung Electronics, SK hynix and Micron launched a joint initiative to standardize robot charging in semiconductor factories, aiming to allow equipment from different manufacturers to share charging stations. The project involves discussions with SEMI to develop common technical requirements for batteries, connectors and charging equipment, but no final standard or public timeline has been announced.

stories.title: While Tesla Argues With Regulators, Others Push Their Automated Driving Systems Into the Mainstream
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz announced that it would start MB.DRIVE Assist Pro trials as early as this year in Germany and the US. It went further and got approval for its self-driving system in Germany, thus stealing the limelight from both Tesla and BMW.

stories.title: Finland confirms Ukrainian drones hit Russian ship Sparta II, now burning in Finnish waters
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones struck the sanctioned Russian container ship Sparta II in Russian territorial waters, causing it to drift into Finnish waters near Loviisa. The fire remains out of control, and Finnish authorities have established an exclusion zone while assessing evacuation options.

also.title: Turkish F-16s scrambled as drone-hit Russian ship Sparta II burns in Finnish waters
Drone-hit Russian cargo ship still on fire in Finnish waters, crew evacuated
Russian cargo ship still on fire off Finland after drone attack

also.title: Ukrainian troops joined the first Drone Crucible exercises with military personnel from the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany and Latvia
US Special Operators Lose Their Own Drone Contest to Royal Marines

stories.title: Armed Forces to Add New Helicopters, Eurofighter Jets and Counter-Drone Systems After Mobilizing 6.402 Billion Euros
stories.summary: The government of Spain will mobilize 6.402 billion euros in zero-interest loans to finance seven special modernization programs for the Armed Forces, according to Royal Decree 1014/2026 of Nov. 18, published in the Spain’s official gazette on Nov. 20. Most of the money, 4.08 billion euros, goes to the Spanish consortium for the Eurofighter program (CEDIEF), under which Spain had already approved 25 new fighter jets under the Halcón II program.

stories.title: Jet-powered drone violates Moldova’s airspace twice
stories.summary: A jet-powered drone violated Moldova’s airspace twice on Saturday, November 21, entering from the direction of the Ukrainian village of Troitske and heading toward Purcari in Ștefan Vodă District. Moldova’s Ministry of Defense said the Air Operations Center was continuing to monitor the republic’s airspace in cooperation with competent authorities and partners.

stories.title: Army Tenders For Chinese Drone Parts Raise Security Concerns
stories.summary: The Drone Federation of India reported that 689 government procurement tenders between March 10, 2021, and November 19, 2026, specified Chinese drones or components, with 580 issued by Indian Army units. The federation warned that these specifications pose national security risks and urged authorities to promote indigenous alternatives.

stories.title: Gold Star families frustrated with Pentagon investigation into Iran drone strike that killed 6 soldiers
stories.summary: Gold Star families told CBS News that briefings on the Pentagon's internal probe into the March 1 drone strike in Kuwait failed to address their concerns about military preparations. The Army briefed at least three families on the unclassified results, which remain unreleased, while a whistleblower complaint alleges senior officials ignored drone threat warnings.

stories.title: Europe's Robot Safety Rules Get Their Biggest Overhaul Since 2011 — and the Clock Is Ticking Toward 2027
stories.summary: The first full revision of the standard since 2011 drops the earlier collaborative operating modes, with safety assessment now carried out on an application-specific basis rather than a purely robot-specific one. Full conformity under the revised ISO 10218-1 and 10218-2 parts demands risk assessments, stricter verification of protective functions, protocols for human-robot collaboration and compliance with IEC 61508 SIL 3.

stories.title: Ice cream stunt offers the inside scoop on robotics
stories.summary: A humanoid robot named Gento Luna served ice cream to a visitor at the 2026 APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen. The robot, developed by Tianji Intelligence, features dexterous hands and full-body force control that yields to cushion impact if it makes unexpected contact with a person or object.

stories.title: Taiwan High Speed Rail Adds 71 Election Trains, With Red-Eye Runs to 1:55 a.m.
stories.summary: Taiwan High Speed Rail added 71 trains for the Nov. 28 local elections, including 10 red-eye departures on Nov. 27 with the last leaving at 1:55 a.m. Reserved standard-car seats on those late trains are 23% off, while free-seat riders at Nangang, Taipei, and Banqiao face metered gates and waits of up to an hour from 5 to 8 p.m. on Nov. 27.

stories.title: Webster: The High-Speed Railway To Nowhere
stories.summary: Austin Democrat John Bucy filed House Bill 270, which wants TxDOT to team up with a private company on a Dallas-to-San Antonio high-speed rail running through Waco and Austin along I-35. The bill claims the train will go as fast as 110 mph and kills the 2017 law that kept the state from dumping money into private high-speed rail projects.

also.title: Texas Democrats push high-speed rail plan after California’s $231B bullet train debacle

stories.title: From ‘bonkers’ flying scooter concept to crewed flight tests: CoolFly’s next steps
stories.summary: CoolFly Aircraft says its Dream ST personal electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft is ready for delivery, following crewed demonstrations in China, France, Canada, and the Maldives. The company is currently selecting dealer partners in the US, with pricing to follow once those partnerships are established.

stories.title: Israeli AIR Autonomous Cargo Aircraft Set to Start Flight Tests in Florida
stories.summary: AIR established its US headquarters at the Orlando-based SunTrax hub, confirming plans to kick off flight plans for both the Air One and Air 120D here. The company announced a major partnership with FDOT that would allow it to start manufacturing its eVTOLs in the US.

also.title: Elroy Air's Chaparral Autonomous Cargo Aircraft Gains Major Orders and Production Momentum

stories.title: DfT and Innovate UK fund 23 rail projects across eight challenges in First of a Kind round
stories.summary: The Department for Transport and Innovate UK announced on 17 November the winners of the First of a Kind 2026 rail competition, with 23 projects funded across eight industry challenges. The round opened on 11 May 2026 with £4.8 million of grant funding, and successful projects were due to start on 1 September 2026.

stories.title: Russian helicopter suspected of Finnish airspace breach amid drone attack on ship
stories.summary: Finland’s Ministry of Defense said on November 21, 2026, that a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating Finnish airspace off Loviisa by as much as 4.1 kilometers. Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen stated the incident was possibly related to rescue operations for the Sparta II, a Russian cargo ship that drifted into Finnish waters after a drone attack.

stories.title: Turkey signs serial production contract for 80 ANKA-3 stealth combat drones
stories.summary: Turkish Aerospace Industries signed a serial production contract for 80 ANKA-3 unmanned combat aerial vehicles through Turkey's Presidency of Defense Industries on May 6, 2024. The company activated a second production line in November 2024 and aims to reduce costs using automotive manufacturing methods while prioritizing delivery to the Turkish Air Force.

stories.title: GST Network adds metro rail as fifth mode of transport in e-way bill system
stories.summary: The GST Network added metro rail as the fifth mode of transport in its e-way bill system, following a government notification dated October 26. The feature is currently available in the Sandbox environment for API users to test, with a live rollout to be announced separately.

also.title: U.S. Army Tests 12-Gauge Shotgun Ammunition to Help Infantry Shoot Down FPV Attack Drones

stories.title: Another European country gives green light to Tesla self-driving cars
stories.summary: Italy granted provisional approval to Tesla's Assisted Driving System (TAD), making it the first major European Union country to embrace the technology. Transport Minister Matteo Salvini said the decision followed a thorough technical feasibility assessment and came ahead of an ongoing European Union approval process.

stories.title: An MQ-25A Stingray-Like Drone Has Emerged at a Chinese Base
stories.summary: A satellite image of an air base at Pucheng in central China’s Shaanxi province has revealed a drone that appears strikingly similar to the Boeing MQ-25A Stingray. The unnamed drone has a wing configuration similar to the MQ-25A Stingray – near-straight wings with a very small sweep angle and a V-tail.

also.title: China’s MQ-25-Like Drone Emerges, Raising Carrier Range Questions
China Spots Unidentified Drone Resembling U.S. MQ-25 Stingray

stories.title: Chinese robots learn from humans in tech hub Shenzhen
stories.summary: AI² Robotics deployed 200 humanoid servers in China, selling up to 300 coffees daily in Shenzhen, while industrial spending on robots using embodied AI leaped 230 percent year-on-year in January-May 2026.

stories.title: US drone boat launches Anduril’s 99-mile-range Altius-600M loitering munition
stories.summary: A prototype U.S. unmanned surface vessel known as Quickfish conducted a test of Anduril Industries' Altius-600M loitering weapon from sea on November 18, 2026. The system can launch Altius-600Ms using a portable mounting system without any permanent changes to the vessel.

stories.title: Knoxville Police Launch Drone First Responder Program
stories.summary: The Knoxville Police Department announced its Drone as First Responder program, which uses semi-autonomous drones launched from 12 Skydio docks to reach nearly any area of the city within 90 seconds of a 911 call. Department policy and state law bar the drones from random patrols or surveillance, and recorded footage is purged after 15 days unless retained as evidence in an ongoing criminal investigation or prosecution.

stories.title: MassRobotics lands Boston marine technology hub role
stories.summary: Massport selected MassRobotics to develop and operate a 560 sq m marine technology testing facility at Boston’s Fish Pier, part of the Blue Edge initiative. Programming is expected to begin during 2027, with the facility targeted to open in 2028.

also.title: Massport Taps MassRobotics for Harbor Robotics Testing

stories.title: ​Win-Win: What is the U.S. Army’s Manufacturing Rodeo, How Does It Involve Ukrainian Drone Manufacturers
No driver, no courier, no problem: China's autonomous tech in action
stories.summary: Guangzhou aims to deploy 10,000 autonomous vehicles by 2027, while Shenzhen tests drone deliveries for AEDs and medicine. These initiatives expand autonomous technology from test zones onto real city streets and into the low-altitude economy.

stories.title: India seeks greater regional cooperation on airspace management with ICAO
stories.summary: Civil Aviation Secretary Samir Sinha expressed India's readiness to work with the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and other member states to improve airspace management during a meeting in Montreal. ICAO leadership encouraged India to take a leading role in strengthening regional airspace management as the country's aviation sector expands rapidly.

stories.title: Quantum Systems and Frontline Robotics Commit €10M to Ukraine
stories.summary: Quantum Systems and Frontline Robotics committed more than €10 million to Ukraine to strengthen long-term support capacity for unmanned systems. The joint venture, Quantum Frontline Industries, is nearing completion of a contract for 10,000 Linza systems and has secured a larger 2027 order from the National Guard of Ukraine.

stories.title: Police Drone Helps Find Three Young Men After Philadelphia Carjacking
stories.summary: Bensalem Township Police used a drone and license plate readers to locate three young men after a Nov. 17 carjacking in Northeast Philadelphia. Officers recovered a .40-caliber semiautomatic handgun and returned the damaged Infiniti to its owner.

stories.title: Bot Auto launches ‘Capacity Grid’ with agreements for 200 million miles of driverless trucking
stories.summary: Bot Auto launched its Capacity Grid, a freight transportation network designed to match customer demand with autonomous trucking capacity, alongside agreements covering 200 million miles of driverless freight operations. The Houston-based company says the new platform will enable shippers and freight brokers to reserve driverless trucking capacity in advance, with agreed prices, routes and operating schedules.

stories.title: Ukraine Launches Production of Engines for MICH 2000 - Drones That Struck Crimean Bridge
stories.summary: The Ukrainian MICH team launched production of piston and impeller engines for MICH 2000 strike drones, which attacked the Crimean Bridge on November 16–17, 2026. The company stated that local production levels have reached 85%, with the base model costing $48,000 and capable of carrying 25 to 60 kg payloads over ranges up to 2,000 km.

stories.title: Army Invites Cleared Industry to Classified C-UAS Threat Briefings
Interdisciplinary Field Benchmarking Evaluates Real-World Public Service
stories.summary: Researchers evaluated three service robots in public settings from 2023 to 2025, finding that realistic operating conditions expose operational trade-offs that uniform laboratory metrics cannot assess. The study tested a SoftBank Pepper humanoid in a Duisburg library, an Angsa cleaning robot in Munich, and an Adlatus SR1300 sweeper in Ulm, revealing that direct quantitative comparisons across heterogeneous use cases remain fundamentally limited.

stories.title: French robotics startup Genesis AI raised $500 million at $3.5 billion valuation
stories.summary: French robotics startup Genesis AI raised $500 million in a Series A round valuing it at $3.5 billion, according to Reuters. CEO Zhou Xian said the funds will increase production of its Eno robot, expand data collection and AI training, and improve object handling, with a customer rollout expected in 2027.

stories.title: Turkish defense firm Dasal delivers ‘Sumru’ surveillance drone
stories.summary: Turkish defense firm Dasal delivered another Sumru fixed-wing surveillance drone to a new operational area. The drone has a maximum takeoff weight of about 15 kilograms, stays airborne for up to 2.5 hours, and operates at altitudes up to 3,000 meters.

stories.title: The world’s most powerful military partners with Africa’s largest manufacturer to test autonomous systems designed to stop aerial threats
stories.summary: The US Army and Royal Moroccan Armed Forces conducted autonomous vehicle tests in Morocco's Tan-Tan region from October 3 to 14, involving more than 10 American defense companies and nine US military organizations. The exercise evaluated driverless ground vehicles designed to detect and stop hostile drones in rough terrain and disrupted electronic conditions, serving as part of the Africa Multidomain Training and Experimentation Center established in July.

stories.title: From a Rs 1 Crore Bet to Rs 205.96 Crore Revenue: How Garuda Aerospace Is Putting Indian Drones on the World Map
stories.summary: Garuda Aerospace reported revenue of Rs 205.96 crore in FY26, up from Rs 123.46 crore the previous year, while expanding its drone manufacturing and services. The Chennai-based company opened a 35,000 sq. ft. facility near Chennai in 2025 to produce drone subsystems locally, aiming for 85-88% indigenous content.

stories.title: An 8.8-ton drone submarine that fits inside a shipping container runs on hydrogen fuel cells adapted from space launches, can cover 3,100 miles or stay out 45 days, and five NATO allies have bought it while the navy back home has about 20 drones for 151,0
stories.summary: Neil Manning, the CEO of Cellula Robotics, told CBC News that five NATO allies have bought the Guardian drone submarine, which fits inside a shipping container and covers 3,100 miles or stays submerged for 45 days.

stories.title: DJI Asked a Court to Make the FCC Decide. The FCC Says That Helps It
stories.summary: DJI filed a petition for a writ of mandamus with the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals on November 3, asking the court to compel the FCC to decide its January 21, 2026, reconsideration request. The FCC and the Department of Justice responded on November 9, arguing that DJI’s request supports their position that the court cannot review the case until the FCC completes its internal review process.

stories.title: Ukraine Unveils AI-Powered Control Station That Detects Drones for Ground Robotic Systems
stories.summary: Ukrainian company TechUnity unveiled AetherLink GS, an AI-powered control station for ground robotic systems that features automatic road keeping and drone detection. The software analyzes video locally to identify FPV drones and keeps vehicles on roads day and night, supporting communications via Starlink, LTE, and Mesh.

stories.title: Ukraine’s drone links ran on a ‘best effort’ subscription
stories.summary: An X account published a memo claiming the Pentagon bought a “Best Effort Subscription” for Ukraine’s satellite terminals, citing a $138.06 million task order. The account argues this commercial structure prevented Washington from overriding SpaceX’s October speed limits, which Ukrainian officials said restricted drone operations to 161 km/h.

stories.title: Why does every drone company seem to be coming to this Houston suburb?
stories.summary: Uber Eats launched drone food deliveries in Spring, Texas, on Nov. 17, using Zipline drones that fly at speeds up to 70mph and carry up to eight pounds of cargo. The service aims to reach one million drone deliveries a day by the end of 2029, expanding to Dallas and other U.S. cities.

stories.title: An enemy drone struck the grounds of a private enterprise in Poltava district
stories.summary: An enemy drone struck the grounds of a private enterprise in Poltava district, with preliminary reports indicating no injuries. A Russian drone also fell onto the Kyiv–Kharkiv–Dovzhansky highway in Poltava district, setting a truck on fire.

stories.title: U.S. Company Vector Introduces BOMBARD Long-Range Strike Drone with 1,100-km Range for Deep-Strike Missions
stories.summary: Utah-based defense technology company Vector unveiled BOMBARD, a pulse-jet-powered strike drone with a 1,100 km range and 50 kg payload, at the Axios Future of Defense Summit on November 19, 2026. The ground-launched system features autonomous navigation and GPS-denied capabilities, designed to provide affordable, scalable long-range precision strikes for U.S. forces.

also.title: The US Bombard UAV has a range of 1,100 km, Ukraine's domestically produced MICH 2000 engine, and Germany's humanoid robot.

stories.title: Overhead Equipment energised on 50-Km Surat–Bilimora bullet train stretch
stories.summary: The Overhead Equipment system on the 50-kilometre Surat–Bilimora section of the Mumbai–Ahmedabad Bullet Train corridor received energisation on November 20. This development covers both the Up and Down lines along the elevated alignment, moving the first Bullet Train project in India closer to further testing activities.

stories.title: Russian Cargo Ship Heading to Kaliningrad Attacked by Two Drones in Baltic Sea
stories.summary: Russian officials reported that two drones attacked a cargo ship bound for Kaliningrad in the Gulf of Finland on November 21, prompting an emergency evacuation of the crew. The incident occurred approximately three nautical miles from Russia’s maritime border, though the vessel’s name, flag, cargo, and the identity of the attackers have not been disclosed.

stories.summary: The Surat–Bilimora section of the Mumbai–Ahmedabad Bullet Train corridor was energised on 20 November 2026. This 50 km elevated alignment includes bridges across four rivers and nearly 94,000 noise barriers, marking a step toward further testing activities.

stories.title: Texas robotaxi crashes: Waymo, Tesla report new incidents
stories.summary: Robotaxi operators in Texas reported 27 new crashes in the latest federal data release, with Waymo accounting for 14 incidents. Tesla reported five crashes, including one involving its Cybercab, while Avride reported seven and Bot Auto reported one.

stories.title: Zoox launches its first robotaxi rides in L.A. County
stories.summary: Zoox launched its first purpose-built autonomous vehicles in Santa Monica on Thursday to serve company employees and their families, with a public wait list opening next year. The pill-shaped cars, which lack steering wheels and pedals, join Zoox's existing public service in San Francisco and Las Vegas, while the company plans to expand to Atlanta, Miami, and Austin.

stories.title: China's PLA Studies Ukraine's Delta, but Its Officers Still Ask First
stories.summary: China’s People’s Liberation Army has published at least four articles in the PLA Daily since July 30 arguing that frontline commanders need more freedom to act without waiting for orders. The series cites Ukraine’s Delta battlefield system, which allows small units to strike without asking first, while maintaining that major operations remain under centralized command.

stories.title: Canada Faces Drone Incursions Over Military Bases
stories.summary: The federal government launched the Defence Drone Initiative in July 2026, earmarking $2.3 billion in Budget 2026 to address at least seven drone incursions over Canadian military bases since 2024. The Department of National Defence declined to comment on specific incidents, citing operational security.

also.title: ‘A wake-up call’: Experts raise alarm over drone incursions at Canadian military bases

stories.title: Video. Japan: Autonomous air taxi completes passenger flight without a pilot
stories.summary: EHang completed Yamanashi’s first passenger demonstration of the EH216-S, an all-electric vertical take-off and landing craft, during a 380-metre flight above Yamanashi Prefecture. A second uncrewed sortie stretched 1,800 metres above the Kamanashi River, showcasing an aircraft engineered to reach speeds of up to 120 km/h and cover roughly 30 kilometres on a single charge.

stories.title: NXP Launches Unified Robotics Platform to Accelerate Trusted Physical AI Development
stories.summary: NXP Semiconductors NV introduced a unified robotics platform featuring an open-source SDK and reference designs for drones, aiming to shorten development cycles from months to days. The platform, available now, integrates security and real-time control, with further support for other autonomous systems expected in the second half of 2027.

stories.title: Watco to use TugVolt autonomous railcars for in-plant switching in Texas
stories.summary: Watco will use Intramotev’s TugVolt autonomous railcars to switch freight cars inside an industrial facility in Seadrift, Texas, its second site for the technology after Wood River, Illinois. Intramotev announced the agreement on November 20, building on revenue service at Wood River where TugVolt units haul soda ash.

stories.title: Drone alert at Sigonella: a security scare unfolds amid renewed military activity in the central Mediterranean
stories.summary: A suspected drone intrusion triggered an alert at NAS Sigonella on Friday evening, 20 November, prompting precautionary instructions to a US Air Force KC-135R Stratotanker to consider diverting to Aviano. The aircraft eventually landed at Sigonella after the alert was lifted.

stories.title: New Castle County Drones Beat Patrol Cars to 756 of 844 Calls
stories.summary: New Castle County Executive Marcus Henry announced that the county's drones were first on scene for 756 of 844 calls between May and October 2026, with 195 calls closed without a patrol car. The county posted a new Technology Transparency Portal containing the drone policy, plate reader rules, and a $50,566,405.15 ten-year Axon contract.

stories.title: Driverless Electric Car Attempts to Park 868 Times Overnight, Leaves Security Guard Baffled
stories.summary: A driverless electric car activated its automatic parking function 868 times overnight in an underground garage in Anhui, China. The vehicle repeatedly maneuvered back and forth until it stopped beside another parked car, baffling a security guard who found the cabin empty.

stories.title: Iran’s IRGC downs US drone over Hormuz as efforts to end war remain stalled
stories.summary: Iranian forces shot down a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, marking the 58th such drone lost, as the US Treasury imposed sanctions on four individuals accused of collecting illicit oil revenues. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that seven conditions, including ending the war and lifting sanctions, must be implemented for the strait to reopen, while US President Donald Trump said Tehran wants a deal that is not acceptable to him.

stories.title: Turkey inducts Kizilelma combat drone, forms F-16-led unmanned task force
stories.summary: Turkey inducted three Baykar Kizilelma unmanned combat aircraft into service on 19 November 2025 and established a new-generation air combat task force led by modernized F-16 fighter jets. The drones are equipped with a Murad radar, Gokdogan missile, FEWS-U electronic warfare suite, and Toygun targeting system, and can cruise at Mach 0.8 while performing 9G-plus maneuvers. Testing of JET-230 and Meteor missile integration is ongoing, and the task force will integrate the Anka-3 unmanned combat aerial vehicle by 2027.

stories.title: Rannon Preparing Small Anti-Drone Missiles for Testing in Ukraine
stories.summary: Latvian defense company Rannon is finalizing compact, unguided air-to-air missiles for testing in Ukraine, with the system expected to be ready by the middle of next year. The 1.2-kilogram missiles, which cover 300 meters in approximately one second, are designed to be mounted on various UAVs and can be launched in configurations of 4 to 12 missiles per carrier.

stories.title: Estonia scrambles NATO allied aircraft over drone threat
stories.summary: The Estonian Armed Forces warned of a possible drone threat in Ida-Viru and Lääne-Viru counties on 21 November, prompting NATO allies, including Turkish fighter jets, to scramble aircraft. The threat was lifted at 06:49, with no violations of Estonian airspace reported.

stories.title: WeRide’s global robotaxi revenue tops 100 million yuan for first time in third quarter
stories.summary: WeRide reported global robotaxi revenue exceeded 100 million yuan for the first time in the third quarter, up 204% year on year. The company’s total revenue reached 320 million yuan, with overseas operations contributing 150 million yuan and accounting for 46% of the total.

stories.title: Ukraine Drone Brief
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces used 11 types of missiles and drones to strike the Crimean Bridge, including the R-360 Neptune and FP-5 Flamingo. Russian forces began using Molniya fixed-wing drones controlled by fibre-optic cable, which fly at about 50 metres and reach up to 30 km behind Ukrainian lines.

stories.title: Transport Secretary discusses London trials of self-driving Waymo cars amid California ban
stories.summary: Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander met Waymo officials to discuss London trials amid a California Department of Motor Vehicles ban on the company's vehicles following multiple construction zone incidents. The DfT stated the meeting followed the introduction of the Government's self-driving vehicles pilot scheme, which will keep safety and local impact at the heart of the trials.

stories.title: Beyond the demo: How Guangdong's Topstar is bringing humanoid robots closer to the factory floor
stories.summary: Guangdong-based robotics company Topstar unveiled Star, a 172-centimeter-tall, 72-kilogram bipedal robot with a 10-kilogram payload capacity, at its TOPS DAY 2026 event in Dongguan. The robot is designed for material handling and sorting tasks as part of a push to bring embodied AI into manufacturing.

stories.title: Delhi to Lucknow in 2 hours, UP's first bullet train to have 13 stations
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi approved the North Bullet Train Corridor, which Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnav stated will connect five states and reduce the Delhi to Lucknow journey to 2 hours and 12 minutes. The Delhi-Varanasi High Speed Rail Corridor’s first phase is expected to include 13 stations in Uttar Pradesh.

stories.title: Bullet Train Update: India’s First High-Speed Rail Service to Begin in Late 2027
stories.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnav stated that India’s inaugural high-speed rail service will commence in the final quarter of 2027, initially running between Surat and Vapi. The service will gradually extend to Mumbai, with the B28 trainset designed for speeds up to 280 km/h undergoing structural testing.
